mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalAttempts, COALESCE(SUM(a.status = 'succeeded'), 0) AS succeededCount, COALESCE(SUM(a.status = 'failed'), 0) AS failedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'succeeded' THEN a.requested_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalImages FROM attempts a JOIN threads t ON a.thread_id = t.id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT a.model_name AS modelName, a.size AS size, a.mode AS mode, COUNT(*) AS usedCount FROM attempts a JOIN threads t ON a.thread_id = t.id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND a.status = 'succeeded' GROUP BY a.model_name, a.size, a.mode ORDER BY usedCount DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT a.id AS attemptId, a.thread_id AS threadId, t.title AS threadTitle, a.results AS results, a.created_at AS createdAt FROM attempts a JOIN threads t ON a.thread_id = t.id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND a.status = 'succeeded' AND a.results IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
